import os; os.chdir\(r''C:\\Users\\ValterAdmin\\Documents\\VS code projects\\EconMScThesis''\)
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use\(''Agg''\)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, seaborn as sns

zones = [''SE1'', ''SE2'', ''SE3'', ''SE4'']
zone_colors = {''SE1'': ''#e74c3c'', ''SE2'': ''#3498db'', ''SE3'': ''#2ecc71'', ''SE4'': ''#f39c12''}
zone_data = {}
start_date, end_date = ''2015-01-01'', ''2025-12-31''
for zone in zones:
    df = pd.read_excel\(f''master data files/2015-2025/Combined_{zone}_Data_2015_2025.xlsx''\)
    df[''Timestamp''] = pd.to_datetime\(df[''Timestamp'']\); df = df.set_index\(''Timestamp''\).sort_index\(\)
    df = df[\(df.index >= pd.to_datetime\(start_date\)\) & \(df.index <= pd.to_datetime\(end_date\)\)]
    zone_data[zone] = df
monthly = {}
for zone in zones:
    df = zone_data[zone]; m = pd.DataFrame\(\)
    m[''Spot_Price''] = df[''Spot_Price''].resample\(''MS''\).mean\(\)
    m[''Spot_Price_Log''] = np.log\(df[''Spot_Price''].clip\(lower=0.01\)\).resample\(''MS''\).mean\(\)
    m[''Volatility''] = df[''Spot_Price''].rolling\(window=24\).std\(\).resample\(''MS''\).mean\(\)
    monthly[zone] = m
yearly = {}
for zone in zones:
    df = zone_data[zone]
    yearly[zone] = \(df[''Wind_Forecast''] / df[''Total_Forecast''].replace\(0, np.nan\) * 100\).resample\(''YS''\).mean\(\)

comparison_dir = ''plots/zone_comparisons''; os.makedirs\(comparison_dir, exist_ok=True\)

fig, axes = plt.subplots\(4, 1, figsize=\(16, 24\)\)
fig.suptitle\(f''Zone Comparison — SE1-SE4 \({date_range_str}\)'', fontsize=16, fontweight=''bold''\)

ax = axes[0]
for z in zones: ax.plot\(monthly[z].index, monthly[z][''Spot_Price''], color=zone_colors[z], linewidth=1.5, label=z, marker=''o'', markersize=2\)
ax.set_title\(''Energy Price Level — Monthly Mean'', fontsize=14, fontweight=''bold''\)
ax.set_ylabel\(''EUR/MWh'', fontsize=12\); ax.legend\(fontsize=11, loc=''upper right''\); ax.grid\(True, alpha=0.3\)
sl = [f''{z}: Mean={zone_data[z][""Spot_Price""].mean\(\):.2f}, Std={zone_data[z][""Spot_Price""].std\(\):.2f}'' for z in zones]
ax.text\(0.02, 0.98, ''\\n''.join\(sl\), transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, verticalalignment=''top'', bbox=dict\(boxstyle=''round'', facecolor=''white'', alpha=0.8\)\)

ax = axes[1]
for z in zones: ax.plot\(monthly[z].index, monthly[z][''Spot_Price_Log''], color=zone_colors[z], linewidth=1.5, label=z, marker=''o'', markersize=2\)
ax.set_title\(''Energy Price Level \(Log\) — Monthly Mean'', fontsize=14, fontweight=''bold''\)
ax.set_ylabel\(''log\(EUR/MWh\)'', fontsize=12\); ax.legend\(fontsize=11, loc=''upper right''\); ax.grid\(True, alpha=0.3\)
sl = [f''{z}: Mean={np.log\(zone_data[z][""Spot_Price""].clip\(lower=0.01\)\).mean\(\):.2f}, Std={np.log\(zone_data[z][""Spot_Price""].clip\(lower=0.01\)\).std\(\):.2f}'' for z in zones]
ax.text\(0.02, 0.98, ''\\n''.join\(sl\), transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, verticalalignment=''top'', bbox=dict\(boxstyle=''round'', facecolor=''white'', alpha=0.8\)\)

ax.set_title\(''Energy Price Volatility \(24h Rolling Std\) — Monthly Mean'', fontsize=14, fontweight=''bold''\)
ax.set_ylabel\(''EUR/MWh'', fontsize=12\); ax.legend\(fontsize=11, loc=''upper right''\); ax.grid\(True, alpha=0.3\)
sl = [f''{z}: Mean={zone_data[z][""Spot_Price""].rolling\(24\).std\(\).dropna\(\).mean\(\):.2f}, Std={zone_data[z][""Spot_Price""].rolling\(24\).std\(\).dropna\(\).std\(\):.2f}'' for z in zones]
ax.text\(0.02, 0.98, ''\\n''.join\(sl\), transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, verticalalignment=''top'', bbox=dict\(boxstyle=''round'', facecolor=''white'', alpha=0.8\)\)

ax = axes[3]
for z in zones: ax.plot\(yearly[z].index, yearly[z], color=zone_colors[z], linewidth=2, label=z, marker=''o'', markersize=5\)
ax.set_title\(''Wind Production Share of Total Production — Yearly Mean \(Forecasted\)'', fontsize=14, fontweight=''bold''\)
ax.set_ylabel\(''Wind Share \(%\)'', fontsize=12\); ax.legend\(fontsize=11, loc=''upper right''\); ax.grid\(True, alpha=0.3\)
sl = [f''{z}: Mean={\(zone_data[z][""Wind_Forecast""]/zone_data[z][""Total_Forecast""].replace\(0,np.nan\)*100\).dropna\(\).mean\(\):.1f}%, Std={\(zone_data[z][""Wind_Forecast""]/zone_data[z][""Total_Forecast""].replace\(0,np.nan\)*100\).dropna\(\).std\(\):.1f}%'' for z in zones]
ax.text\(0.02, 0.98, ''\\n''.join\(sl\), transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, verticalalignment=''top'', bbox=dict\(boxstyle=''round'', facecolor=''white'', alpha=0.8\)\)

axes[-1].set_xlabel\(''Date'', fontsize=12\)
plt.tight_layout\(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.97]\)
plt.savefig\(os.path.join\(comparison_dir, ''zone_comparison_all.png''\), dpi=300, bbox_inches=''tight''\); plt.close\(\)
print\(''Done''\)
